DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知のどの欄についてのご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aling hanay po ng abiso ang tanong?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 受取日という欄です。来週提出するので、来週の日付を書きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取日欄に予定提出日を書くか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Ang araw ng pagtanggap. Sa susunod na linggo ako magsusumite kaya petsa ba sa susunod na linggo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong sa wikang Hapon kung planong pagsusumite ang isusulat sa araw ng pagtanggap.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通知を受け取った日と、回答を提出する日は別です。通知はいつ届きましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba ang pagtanggap ng abiso at pagsusumite ng sagot. Kailan po dumating?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日です。提出する日を書く欄だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知は昨日届き提出日欄と誤解したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Kahapon. Akala ko po ay araw ng pagsusumite ang hanay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag sa wikang Hapon na kahapon dumating at maling akalang petsa ng pagsusumite.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 昨日届いたという情報を記録する欄か、担当に確認します。回答期限は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tatanungin kung hanay na itatala ang pagdating kahapon. Mababasa po ang deadline ng sagot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今月十五日とあります。受取日を書けば期限もその日から自動で延びるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 記載期限を示し受取日で延長されるとは考えないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ikalabinlima ng buwang ito. Hindi ko iisiping awtomatikong mapapahaba mula sa araw ng pagtanggap kapag isinulat iyon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang takda at sabihing hindi iisiping mapapahaba sa araw ng pagtanggap sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期限の扱いも通知の担当へ確認しましょう。回答の準備はできていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tiyakin din ang deadline sa tagapangasiwa ng abiso. Handa na po ang sagot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだ必要な資料が一つありません。提出予定日を書くだけで間に合うことにせず、相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不足資料があり期限について相談したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: May isang kailangang dokumento pang wala. Gusto kong kumonsulta at hindi iisiping aabot sa pagsulat lamang ng planong petsa.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin sa wikang Hapon na may kulang at nais kumonsulta sa deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料について担当へ状況を伝えます。何が不足していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapasa ang sitwasyon ng dokumento sa tagapangasiwa. Ano po ang kulang?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務先の確認書です。受け取った日、不足している資料、提出できる見込みを分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 不足資料と受取日と準備見込みを分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Confirmation letter ng trabaho. Hiwalay kong ipaliliwanag ang natanggap na araw, kulang, at tantiya ng pagsusumite.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang kulang na dokumento, pagtanggap, at tantiya ng paghahanda sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通知と準備状況を見て、回答方法と期限について担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan po. Titingnan ng tagapangasiwa ang abiso at paghahanda at gagabay sa sagot at deadline.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 腕の赤みを診てもらいたいです。肌のことなので、美容相談の列に並びました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 肌の症状で美容相談の列へ並んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Gusto kong ipatingin ang pamumula ng braso. Tungkol sa balat kaya pumila ako sa beauty consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag sa wikang Hapon na pumila sa beauty consultation dahil sa sintomas ng balat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 美容の相談と、症状についての診療受付は分けて確認します。美容の施術をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hiwalay ang beauty consultation at pagpapatingin ng sintomas. Beauty procedure po ba ang gusto?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、施術の希望ではありません。赤みと痛みがあるので、診療を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 施術希望でなく赤みと痛みの診療を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi po procedure. May pamumula at sakit kaya nais kong magpatingin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Humiling ng pagpapatingin sa pamumula at sakit at hindi beauty procedure sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 症状が出た時点と、使い始めたものがあれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Pakisabi kung kailan nagsimula at kung may bagong ginamit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 赤みに気付いたのは昨日です。新しいクリームを使いましたが、それが原因とはまだわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発症時点とクリーム使用を原因未確定の経過として伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Kahapon ko napansin ang pamumula. Gumamit ng bagong cream pero hindi pa alam kung iyon ang sanhi.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang simula at cream bilang nangyari nang hindi tiyak ang sanhi sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今の症状についても診療担当へ伝えます。腕以外にもありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ipapasa rin ang kasalukuyang sintomas sa medikal na kawani. May iba po ba sa braso?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今見えているのは両腕です。写真では片腕だけですが、実際の範囲は両腕だと伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 片腕の写真と実際の両腕の症状範囲を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Ang nakikita ngayon ay parehong braso. Isa lamang sa larawan pero gustong sabihing pareho ang tunay na saklaw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang larawan ng isang braso at tunay na parehong braso sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一般の診療受付へご案内します。クリームの情報もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ituturo ang general medical reception. May impormasyon po ng cream?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 容器の写真があります。肌の相談なら美容サービスを申し込むことだと考えず、症状と製品情報を診療担当へ説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容器写真を示し美容申込でなく診療担当へ症状を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: May larawan ng lalagyan. Hindi ko iisiping beauty service application ang anumang tanong sa balat; ipaliliwanag ko ang sintomas at produkto sa medikal na kawani.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang lalagyan at ipaliwanag ang sintomas sa medikal na kawani at hindi beauty application sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。施術の申し込みではなく、赤みと痛みの診療希望として受付へ引き継ぎます。こちらの案内窓口でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan po. Ipapasa bilang pagpapatingin sa pamumula at sakit at hindi procedure application. Maghintay sa information counter na ito.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 鍵を拾われたのですね。どちらにありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nakakita po kayo ng susi. Saan ito?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 歩道です。名札に住所らしい文字があるので、そこへ郵送しようかと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩道で拾い名札の住所らしい場所へ送ろうと思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Sa sidewalk. May tila address sa tag kaya naisip kong ipadala roon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang sidewalk at balak ipadala sa tila address ng tag sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身で送らず、こちらで確認します。文字の意味は確かめていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Huwag ipadala mismo; dito namin titiyakin. Alam po ang kahulugan ng sulat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、住所なのか管理番号なのかわかりません。今も持ち主の家だとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 文字の意味も現在の持ち主住所かも不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi, hindi alam kung address o management number. Hindi ko rin masasabing bahay ng kasalukuyang may-ari.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi alam ang sulat o kung kasalukuyang address ng may-ari sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そのままお渡しください。鍵は何本ありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Ibigay nang ganito. Ilan pong susi?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二本です。使える鍵か試しておらず、名札も外していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 鍵二本を加工も試用もせず渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Dalawa. Hindi ko sinubukang gamitin at hindi inalis ang tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihing ibibigay ang dalawang susi nang hindi binago o sinubukan sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾った時刻を教えてください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正午ごろです。近くの建物の鍵穴に入れて確かめることもしませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾った時刻と建物で試していないことを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mga tanghali. Hindi ko rin ipinasok sa keyhole ng malapit na gusali para subukan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang oras at hindi pagsubok sa gusali sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。届けた方の情報を伺い、必要な手続きを説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Salamat. Itatanong ang impormasyon ng naghatid at ipaliliwanag ang kailangan.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。名札の文字をネットに載せて持ち主を探すこともせず、こちらに任せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名札をネットへ載せず届け出の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakisuyo. Hindi ko rin ilalagay sa internet ang tag para maghanap ng may-ari at nais kong ipaubaya rito.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Huwag ilathala ang tag at humiling ng gabay sa pag-uulat sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。拾った状況と特徴を記録し、届け出の扱いをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan. Itatala ang kalagayan at katangian at ipaliliwanag ang paghawak sa ulat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような転居のご相談ですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ建物の二階から三階へ移りました。建物が同じなら届け先も変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ建物の階移動で届け先が変わるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Mula ikalawa sa ikatlong palapag ng parehong gusali. Kung parehong gusali, nagbabago rin ba ang padadalhan?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung nagbabago ang padadalhan sa paglipat ng palapag sa parehong gusali sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 部屋番号が変わったのですね。以前と現在の住所表記を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nagbago po ang room number. Matitiyak ang dati at kasalukuyang address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 以前は二〇一、今は三〇一です。建物名だけ同じなので、何もしなくてよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧二〇一と新三〇一を示して手続不要と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Dati201 at ngayon301. Pareho lang ang building name kaya akala ko ay walang gagawin.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang dating201 at bagong301 at akalang walang proseso sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 郵便の扱いについて担当に確認しましょう。転居に関する手続きはされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tanungin ang tagapangasiwa sa koreo. Nakagawa na po ng proseso ng paglipat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。以前の部屋に届いたと聞いたので、必要な手続きを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未手続で旧部屋への到着を聞いたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi pa. Narinig kong dumating sa dating kuwarto kaya nais malaman ang kailangan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang walang proseso at narinig na pagdating sa dating kuwarto sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 以前の部屋には、現在どなたか住まれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: May kasalukuyan pong nakatira sa dating kuwarto?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: それは知りません。自分の部屋だったからといって、今の郵便受けを開けることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧部屋の現住人は不明で郵便受けを開けないと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi alam. Hindi ko bubuksan ang mailbox ngayon dahil lamang dati kong kuwarto.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin na hindi alam ang kasalukuyang residente at hindi bubuksan ang mailbox sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。転居の手続きと、届いた郵便の確認方法を分けて案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Naiintindihan. Hiwalay na ipaliliwanag ang moving procedure at pagtiyak ng dumating na koreo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。今後の差出人にも部屋番号を知らせますが、それだけで以前の郵便が動くとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 差出人への変更連絡と既着郵便の対応を分けて頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pakisuyo. Ipapabatid din ang room number sa susunod na magpapadala pero hindi iisiping gagalaw ang dating koreo sa ganoon lamang.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hilingin nang hiwalay ang abiso sa magpapadala at paghawak ng dumating nang koreo sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当が必要な手続きを確認します。旧住所と新住所の部屋番号を正確に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Titiyakin ng tagapangasiwa ang kailangan. Tumpak na sabihin ang luma at bagong room number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録住所の変更をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Nais po baguhin ang registered address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、以前の住所はもう間違いなので、記録を全部消してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧住所を全部消して新住所にしたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, mali na ang dati kaya burahin lahat ng tala.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Sabihin na gustong burahin ang lumang address at gawing bago sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の住所の変更と、過去の記録の扱いは別です。以前はその住所にお住まいでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Magkaiba ang pagbabago ng kasalukuyan at paghawak ng nakaraang tala. Dati po roon nakatira?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、当時は正しい住所でした。最初から誤登録だったのではなく、今月引っ越しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧住所は当時正しく今月の転居だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, tama noon. Hindi maling rehistro mula umpisa; lumipat ako ngayong buwan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama na tama noon ang luma at ngayon lumipat sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、転居による変更として確認します。新しい住所がわかる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin bilang pagbabago dahil sa paglipat. May materyal po ng bago?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。過去の履歴を消すことではなく、今後の連絡先を直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 過去履歴ではなく今後の連絡先変更を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Ito. Nais kong baguhin ang susunod na contact at hindi burahin ang lumang history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Hilingin ang susunod na contact change at hindi past history sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が必要な資料と変更の範囲を確認します。発送済みの郵便についてお心当たりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ang kailangan at saklaw. May alam po na naipadala nang koreo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月の書類が発送されたかもしれません。住所を直せば発送済みの物も戻るとは思わず、別に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 発送済み郵便の扱いを住所変更と別に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Baka naipadala na ang dokumento ng buwang ito. Hindi iisiping babalik ang naipadala sa pagbabago ng address at hiwalay kong ikokonsulta.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Kumonsulta sa naipadalang koreo nang hiwalay sa address change sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発送状況も担当へ確認します。電話番号も変わりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tatanungin din ang shipping status. Nagbago po ang telepono?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電話番号は同じです。変わった住所と変わっていない番号を分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所のみ変更で電話番号は同じと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Pareho pa. Hiwalay kong sasabihin ang nabagong address at hindi nabagong numero.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin na address lamang ang nagbago at pareho ang telepono sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。転居による住所変更と発送済み郵便の状況を、それぞれ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan. Hiwalay na tiyakin ang address change sa paglipat at naipadalang koreo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どの表示についてお聞きになりたいですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この飲み物は小さい瓶なので、二人で飲むには足りないでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小瓶の量で二人分足りるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Maliit ang bote kaya kulang ba para sa dalawang iinom?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung sapat sa dalawa ang maliit na bote sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表には濃縮とあります。飲む前の作り方をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: May concentrated sa harap. Nabasa po ang paghahanda bago inumin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見ていません。そのまま飲むものだと思って、瓶の量だけで比べていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 濃縮の作り方を読まずそのまま飲むと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi. Akala ay diretsong iinumin kaya dami lamang sa bote ang ihinambing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na hindi nabasa ang concentrated preparation at inakalang ready to drink sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示された割合で薄める商品か、説明を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tingnan kung kailangang palabnawin sa nakasulat na ratio.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。薄める前の量と、作った後の量を分けて知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希釈前後の量を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Pakisuyo. Gusto kong malaman nang hiwalay ang dami bago palabnawin at pagkatapos ihanda.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tiyakin ang dami bago at matapos palabnawin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらには作り方と一回分の目安があります。ご自宅で薄める準備はできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: May paraan at sukatan ng isang serving. Kaya po maghanda sa bahay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 計量できる容器はありません。目分量で濃さを決めず、必要な道具も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 計量器具がなく目分量にせず道具を確認したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Walang panukat na lalagyan. Hindi huhulaan ang tapang at gustong tiyakin ang gamit din.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin na walang measuring tool at hindi tatantiyahin at nais tiyakin ang kagamitan sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのまま飲む別の商品もあります。用途はどちらが合いそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: May ibang ready-to-drink na produkto. Alin po ang mas angkop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はすぐ二人で飲みたいので、そのまま飲める商品と合計量を比較します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: すぐ飲む用途から希釈不要の商品と量を比較したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ngayon ay agad iinumin ng dalawa kaya ihahambing ang ready-to-drink at kabuuang dami.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin na ihahambing ang hindi kailangang palabnawin at dami dahil iinumin agad sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。作り方と今回の用途を確認し、瓶の大きさだけで選ばないようにしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan. Tiyakin ang paghahanda at layunin at huwag pumili sa laki ng bote lamang.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩する場所をお探しですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、あの運動区画が空いているので、中で少し休んでもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 空いている運動区画内で休めるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Opo, bakante ang sports area kaya maaari bang magpahinga sandali sa loob?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung maaaring magpahinga sa bakanteng sports area sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 空いて見えても予約や利用条件がある場合があります。区画の案内はご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Kahit mukhang bakante, maaaring may reservation at kondisyon. Nabasa po ang gabay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。誰もいなければ、散歩道と同じように使えると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 人がいなければ散歩道同様に使えると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Hindi. Akala kung walang tao ay magagamit na parang walking path.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag ang akalang parang walking path kung walang tao sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内と利用状況を担当に確認しましょう。運動の利用をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tiyakin sa tagapangasiwa ang gabay at paggamit. Sports po ang gusto?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ、休むだけです。区画を予約するより、散歩の人が使えるベンチを知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 運動ではなく一般利用のベンチを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Hindi, pahinga lamang. Sa halip na magpareserba, gusto kong malaman ang bangkong para sa naglalakad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Humiling ng karaniwang bangko at hindi sports sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 区画の外の休憩場所を確認します。何人で休まれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titingnan ang pahingahan sa labas. Ilan po?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二人です。通路に荷物を置いて席を作ることはせず、座れる場所を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二人で通路へ荷物を広げず座りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dalawa. Naghahanap ng mauupuan nang hindi naglalatag ng gamit sa daan para gumawa ng puwesto.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin na dalawang uupo nang hindi naglalatag sa daan sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 区画の外にある二人で座れるベンチはこちらです。運動区画を通り抜けたい予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Narito ang bangko para sa dalawa sa labas. Balak pong dumaan sa sports area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありません。区画の中を近道にせず、案内された散歩道からベンチへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 区画を近道にせず案内された道を使うと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Wala. Hindi shortcut ang loob at sa itinurong walking path ako dadaan sa bangko.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin na hindi shortcut ang area at itinurong daan ang gagamitin sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらの散歩道からベンチへお進みください。予約区画に入らず、二人で休める場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Kung gayon, dito sa walking path tungo sa bangko. Makapagpapahinga ang dalawa nang hindi papasok sa reserved area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どちらの出口へ向かわれますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 五番出口です。五号車に乗れば、近くで降りられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出口と同じ番号の車両が近いか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Exit5. Kung sasakay sa car5, malapit po ba ang pagbaba?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Itanong kung malapit ang car na parehong numero ng exit sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出口番号と車両番号は対応しているとは限りません。到着駅はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Hindi laging tugma ang exit number at car number. Aling arrival station po?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この駅です。同じ五だから近いと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 到着駅を示し番号対応を思い込んだと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Itong istasyon. Akala ay malapit dahil parehong5.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang arrival station at akalang magkatugma ang numero sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 到着する乗り場から出口への経路を確認しましょう。歩く距離を短くしたいのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Tingnan ang ruta mula arrival platform sa exit. Gusto pong maikling lakad?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、重い荷物があります。階段の少なさも含めて選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物が重く歩行距離と階段を少なくしたいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo, mabigat ang gamit. Gusto kong pumili pati sa kaunting hagdan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin na mabigat ang gamit at gustong kaunting lakad at hagdan sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出口までの道と設備を確認します。目的地は五番出口のすぐ近くですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Titiyakin ang daan at kagamitan sa exit. Katabi po ng exit5 ang destinasyon?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いいえ、宿泊先の案内に五番とあります。別の出口からも行けるか宿に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宿の指定出口以外から行けるか確認したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Hindi, exit5 ang sabi sa lodging guide. Gusto kong itanong sa lodging kung maaari sa iba.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihing nais tiyakin ang ibang exit kaysa itinakda ng lodging sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 出口を決めてから、その出口へ向かいやすい車両を係員に確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Pagkatapos pumili ng exit, itanong sa kawani ang car na madaling makarating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。番号だけで五号車に決めず、宿への道と駅内の道を合わせて考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 駅内と宿への経路を合わせて車両を選ぶ方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Naiintindihan. Hindi pipili ng car5 sa numero lang at pagsasamahin ang daan sa lodging at loob ng station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang planong piliin ang car gamit ang station at lodging routes sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その順で確認しましょう。今の乗り場と到着駅の案内をお示しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Tiyakin sa gayong pagkakasunod. Ipapakita ang kasalukuyang platform at arrival station guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入のご相談ですね。前の住所を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Tungkol po sa moving-in. Tingnan ang dating address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 町名は前も今も本町なので、同じ市内の引っ越しだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ町名で市内転居と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Parehong Honcho dati at ngayon kaya akala ay same-city move.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipaliwanag na parehong town name kaya inakalang same-city move sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 町名だけでなく市区町村名も確認しましょう。住所の書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Tingnan hindi lang town name kundi municipality. May address document po?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、前の書類と新しい契約の住所です。市の名前は違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前後の書類を示して市名の違いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Opo, dating document at bagong contract address. Iba ang city name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang luma at bago at tiyakin ang city difference sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手続きの種類を担当が確認します。すでに何か申請されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Titiyakin ng tagapangasiwa ang procedure type. May na-apply na po?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。町名が同じだからと市内の変更用紙を使わず、必要な手続きを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未申請で適切な用紙と手続きを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Wala pa. Hindi gagamit ng same-city form dahil lang parehong town name; itatanong ang kailangan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Itanong ang wastong form at procedure na wala pang application sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実際に引っ越した日も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Pakisabi rin ang tunay na moving day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一昨日です。契約を結んだのは先月ですが、住み始めたのは一昨日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 契約日と実際の転居日を分けて伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Dalawang araw nakalipas. Contract noong nakaraang buwan pero nagsimulang tumira dalawang araw nakalipas.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ihiwalay ang contract date at tunay na moving day sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当に住所全体と日付を伝えます。ご家族も一緒に移られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapasa ang buong address at petsa. Kasama po ang pamilya sa paglipat?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回は私だけです。前の家に残る家族を転入する人に含めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分のみ移り残る家族は対象外と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ako lang. Huwag isama sa moving-in ang naiwang pamilya sa dating bahay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin na sarili lamang lumipat at hindi saklaw ang nanatiling pamilya sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。町名、市名、転居日、対象者を分けて確認し、担当へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan. Ihiwalay ang town, city, moving day, at target at ituturo ang tagapangasiwa.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 変更したい予約はどちらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Aling appointment po ang gustong baguhin?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金曜日の診察です。画面に木曜日の空きがあるので、そこへ移したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 元予約と画面の別曜日の空き枠を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Friday consultation. May Thursday slot sa screen kaya gusto kong ilipat doon.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ipakita ang dating appointment at ibang araw na slot sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 木曜日の枠は同じ担当の診療ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Parehong doctor po ang Thursday slot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: よく見ると医師の名前が違います。時間だけ見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 医師名が違い時刻だけ見ていたと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Iba pala ang doctor name pagtingin nang maayos. Oras lamang ang tiningnan.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Itama na iba ang doctor at oras lamang ang tiningnan sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 診療内容や担当の扱いを確認する必要があります。日時だけの変更を希望されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Kailangang tiyakin ang treatment at assignment. Oras at araw lamang po ang gusto?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、同じ相談を続けたいです。別の医師で同じように受けられるかは自分では決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ相談を継続したく別担当の適否は未判断と示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Opo, parehong konsultasyon ang itutuloy. Hindi ko pagpapasyahang pareho sa ibang doktor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Sabihin na tuloy ang parehong konsultasyon at hindi hinusgahan ang ibang doctor sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ確認します。金曜日の何時が難しいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tatanungin ang tagapangasiwa. Anong oras po ng Friday ang mahirap?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 午前が仕事と重なります。金曜日の午後か、同じ担当の別日なら相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 難しい時間帯と同じ担当での代替候補を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Umaga ay kasabay ng trabaho. Friday afternoon o ibang araw ng parehong doctor ang puwede.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Sabihin ang mahirap na oras at alternatibo sa parehong doctor sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 候補を伝えます。現在の予約はまだ残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Ipapasa ang opsiyon. Naroon pa po ang kasalukuyang appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。別枠を新しく取って二つにせず、変更方法の説明を待っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元予約を残し重複予約せず変更案内を待つと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Opo. Hindi kukuha ng bago para maging dalawa at hinihintay ang paliwanag ng pagbabago.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Sabihin na naroon ang luma at walang duplicate habang naghihintay ng gabay sa wikang Hapon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。同じ診療を継続する希望と候補日時を、担当に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-13214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Naiintindihan. Tiyakin sa tagapangasiwa ang pagpapatuloy ng parehong consultation at petsang opsiyon.
